name: Fennel marinara
why: Back to a normal soffritto-style marinara — onion and garlic sweated properly instead of worked around.
steps: Sweat the diced onion in olive oil with salt for 8 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and cook 1 minute more, just until fragrant — don't let it brown.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, and a pinch of chili. Simmer 30 minutes uncovered.
accommodate: Set aside 2 cups of crushed tomatoes before the onion and garlic go in. Simmer that portion on its own with just oregano and a little extra olive oil — it's flatter, so finish it with a splash of vinegar and more salt for your spouse.
